questions.question_text: Situation 1: A rectangle is 8 m wide and 12 m long. What is its area?
questions.question_text_th: Situation 1: A rectangle is 8 m wide and 12 m long. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area = width x length = 8 x 12 = 96 sq m
questions.explanation_th: Area = width x length = 8 x 12 = 96 sq m
questions.hint_th: Area of rectangle = width x length

questions.question_text: Situation 3: A rectangle is 7 m wide and 15 m long. What is its perimeter?
questions.question_text_th: Situation 3: A rectangle is 7 m wide and 15 m long. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (width + length) = 2 x (7 + 15) = 2 x 22 = 44 m
questions.explanation_th: Perimeter = 2 x (width + length) = 2 x (7 + 15) = 2 x 22 = 44 m

questions.question_text: Situation 6: A trapezoid has parallel sides 10 m and 14 m, height 6 m. What is its area?
questions.question_text_th: Situation 6: A trapezoid has parallel sides 10 m and 14 m, height 6 m. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x (sum of parallel sides) x height = 1/2 x (10+14) x 6 = 1/2 x 24 x 6 = 72 sq m

questions.question_text: Situation 10: A parallelogram has base 16 m and height 9 m. A rectangle has width 12 m and length 12 m. Which has larger area?
questions.question_text_th: Situation 10: A parallelogram has base 16 m and height 9 m. A rectangle has width 12 m and length 12 m. Which has larger area?
choices: They are equal at 144 sq m
questions.correct_answer: They are equal at 144 sq m
questions.answer: They are equal at 144 sq m
questions.explanation: Parallelogram area = 16 x 9 = 144 sq m. Rectangle area = 12 x 12 = 144 sq m. Equal.
questions.explanation_th: Parallelogram area = 16 x 9 = 144 sq m. Rectangle area = 12 x 12 = 144 sq m. Equal.
questions.hint_th: Parallelogram area = base x height. Rectangle area = width x length.
